question: The institution responsible for construction and maintenance of India's highways is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Highway Authority of India**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Highway Authority of India (NHAI)** is responsible for the construction and maintenance of India's highways.
 
• Established in 1988, NHAI operates under the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways.
 
• It is tasked with the development, maintenance, and management of the national highways network.
 
• NHAI ensures the smooth functioning of the national highway system, which is crucial for the country's transportation infrastructure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **National Highways Development Project (NHDP)** is one of the major projects undertaken by NHAI to upgrade, rehabilitate and widen major highways.
 
• India has one of the largest road networks in the world, and the efficient management of this network is crucial for economic development.
 
• The NHAI also focuses on enhancing road safety, reducing travel time, and improving the overall quality of the highways.
 
• The authority collaborates with various state governments and private sector entities to achieve its objectives.
